//: Auto-loaded by Claude Code. Registers the memini MCP server (memory_remember/recall/get/forget). Works local AND remote: set MEMINI_BASE_URL to your remote memini (the /mcp endpoint is derived) and MEMINI_API_KEY to its token. MEMINI_MCP_URL overrides the derived endpoint; MEMINI_URL/MEMINI_TOKEN are accepted aliases for back-compat. headersHelper resolves the per-project namespace + bearer via mcp-headers.mjs. NOTE: headersHelper runs in a bare shell and does NOT receive ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} (unlike hooks/command), so we can't put it in the path directly. The SessionStart hook writes the plugin root to $XDG_CACHE_HOME/memini/plugin-root and this helper reads it to locate the script. On a cold first connect (before SessionStart) it falls back to emitting just the bearer token so auth still succeeds and Claude Code doesn't drop into OAuth discovery.

memini.headersHelper: R=$(cat "${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/memini/plugin-root" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$R" ] && [ -f "$R/scripts/mcp-headers.mjs" ]; then exec node "$R/scripts/mcp-headers.mjs"; fi; t="${MEMINI_API_KEY:-$MEMINI_TOKEN}"; if [ -n "$t" ]; then printf '{"Authorization":"Bearer %s"}' "$t"; else printf '{}'; fi
